description: This file defines the setup wizard and configuration logic for IRC channel integration in the OpenClaw plugin SDK, including account setup, allowlist management, NickServ configuration, and channel policies.

methods.name: parseListInput
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a list of trimmed, non-empty entries separated by newlines, commas, or semicolons.

methods.name: normalizeGroupEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a raw IRC group entry, converting it into a proper channel target or returning null if invalid.

methods.name: promptIrcNickServConfig
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure NickServ settings for an IRC account, including service name, password, registration, and email.
